findingDetails.title: A hardened writer turns silent on a platform where mode bits carry no meaning
findingDetails.scopeProof: both files are in reviewScopeFiles; the predicate is new in this fix batch and metrics.ts:264-273 is added by git diff HEAD
findingDetails.case: on win32 the hook writes a diagnostic record, mkdir and chmod succeed, isOwnedPrivateDir fails on mode 0o777 and every durable line is dropped with exit 0 and empty stderr
findingDetails.claim: isOwnedPrivateDir's mode check is POSIX-only and metrics.ts converts the false negative into a silent no-op
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: grepped runtime/lib, runtime/handlers and hooks for a win32 or process.platform branch around the metrics and shadow writes; none exists in the changed set
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the advisor may not support win32 at all, which would make the false negative unreachable
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: drop if the advisor declares POSIX-only support

findingDetails.title: A tracked module imports a file that git does not yet contain
findingDetails.scopeProof: importers and the missing module both sit inside the declared target; evidence is git status and git check-ignore, neither of which writes
findingDetails.case: an operator commits the batch with git commit -a; the three importers ship without owned-private-dir.ts, so the hook throws ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on the first prompt in the next clone
findingDetails.claim: the fix batch depends at import time on an untracked, unstaged source file
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: git check-ignore exits 1 (not ignored) and git diff HEAD --stat omits the module, so it is neither ignored nor in the diff
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: the file may be added to the index before the batch is committed
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: drop once the module is added to the index
